frequency_question: How often do intended macroprudential buffer adjustments successfully clear formal voting, announcement, and definitional thresholds without technical miss?
membership_rule: Includes any formal regulatory announcement regarding countercyclical capital buffer adjustments by the central bank board; excludes informal speeches, staff working papers, and consultative proposals that are not final policy decisions.
provenance_note: claims 15 cases from only 4 named (3.8x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 15 named major implementations; all met formal press release criteria when decided.
known_gaps: Minor variations in terminology across different central bank communication channels.
skeleton: Regulatory capital buffer activation decisions matching formal board press release criteria across major jurisdictions since establishment of Basel III standards.
multiplier: 15 successful official instrument announcements out of 15 intended policy implementations meeting formal criteria.
validity_reason: Central bank communication and official press release protocols for regulatory buffers are stable and institutionalized.
